lee-new: Hi team, first on-call rotation next week. Quick questions: runbook link 403, and PD mobile not notifying. Who should I ping?

tasha-sre: Welcome Lee! Ping me for runbook access and DM your LDAP username. For PD mobile, check app notifications + add SMS fallback in PD settings.

lee-new: LDAP is lee.w. Also, my onboarding email mentioned a 2-incident shadow requirement. What's expected from me during the shadow?

tasha-sre: For the first two incidents we want you to do the ack, set severity, and write the timeline bullets. We'll talk through playbook steps and do hands-on mitigation.

oncall-bot: Dry-run scheduled: incident-sim-177513 at 2026-06-10T15:00:00Z (staging only).

doc-owner: Lee, I've added you to group:oncall-readers. Try reloading the docs. If you still see 403 tell me and I'll escalate.

lee-new: Docs open now, thanks. One more thing: is there a preferred template for timeline entries?

tasha-sre: Use short ISO timestamp bullets. Example: `2026-06-10T15:02Z - Alert fired; 15:04Z - Acknowledged (Pager A); 15:10Z - Mitigation applied (scaled replicas); 15:28Z - Resolved`

lee-new: Great. I'll join the dry-run and set up redwoodctl tonight. Appreciate the help!
